Slave Dynasty




The Slave Dynasty (also called the Mamluk Dynasty) was the first
ruling dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate. It was established by Qutb-ud-
din Aibak in 1206 after the death of Muhammad Ghori. The dynasty
ruled for 84 years (1206–1290) before being overthrown by the Khilji
Dynasty.
